instruction: Look at task-005_initial.scad. Build a four-port pipe manifold from CSG primitives. The finished envelope must be 120 x 70 x 50 mm. Use a vertical main body with 40 mm outside diameter and 20 mm through bore, add a horizontal X-axis branch with 22 mm outside diameter through the full width at z=25, add a Y-axis branch with 16 mm outside diameter through the full depth at z=25, and add four 5 mm flange bolt holes at (+/-28,+/-18). Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-005_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
